name: Keen Edge
text: The third slash of the chain is Keen: it hits far harder.

name: Peerless Edge
text: Evolved form of Keen Edge. Every third finisher that lands throws a gold cross wave, and for 3 seconds every slash hits like the third.

name: Skybreaker
text: The third slash launches foes, and air slashes hit harder and spike them down.

name: Heavenfall
text: Evolved form of Skybreaker. A spike crashes into the foes below it and stuns them.

name: Reaping Sweep
text: The first slash sweeps and drags foes into the chain.

name: Crystal Harvest
text: Evolved form of Reaping Sweep. The sweep reaps every foe up to 140 px ahead and drags them in.

name: Phase Cut
text: When the second slash lands, Kael phases through the foe, so the third slash strikes its back.

name: Phantom Passage
text: Evolved form of Phase Cut. The phase runs through every foe up to 160 px ahead and cuts them all.

name: Crystal Aegis
text: Every blow Kael blocks sets a crystal in his guard, and his next parry shatters them all at the attacker.

name: Diamond Aegis
text: Evolved form of Crystal Aegis. Every blocked blow also throws a crystal lance back at the attacker, and the shatter throws foes high.

name: Warpcraft
text: Warp Strike recharges faster and hits harder, and its arrival blasts the foes around.

name: Rift Walker
text: Evolved form of Warpcraft. Once every 4 seconds an arrival recharges the warp at once.

name: Blink Step
text: Kael stays untouchable after each dash, leaves a cutting afterimage, and gains air dashes.

name: Shadow Step
text: Evolved form of Blink Step. Each afterimage cuts twice and reaches twice as far.

name: Spellwarp
text: Warp Strike pours the selected spell into the sword, and spell cooldowns are shorter.

name: Arcane Arrival
text: Evolved form of Spellwarp. Every arrival leaves the selected spell ready to cast.

name: Passing Cut
text: Dashing through foes cuts every foe passed.

name: Phantom Rush
text: Evolved form of Passing Cut. A phantom cuts every passed foe again a moment later.

name: Sky Dance
text: One more air slash, wall kicks that cut, and a stomp after air slashes.

name: Comet Dance
text: Evolved form of Sky Dance. The stomp lands as a comet that reaches 70 px and draws foes in.

name: Fire Flask
text: Fire sets foes burning, and the sword makes burning foes flare.

name: Sunflask
text: Evolved form of Fire Flask. Each fire blast throws three smaller blasts at the foes near it.

name: Ice Spikes
text: Ice freezes longer, and a slash shatters a frozen foe.

name: Glacier Bloom
text: Evolved form of Ice Spikes. A shatter freezes the foes it splashes.

name: Lightning
text: Thunder arcs on to more foes, and thunder-infused slashes arc too.

name: Thunderhead
text: Evolved form of Lightning. Thunder strikes the same foe again 0.3 s later.

name: Crystal Splinters
text: Sword blows lodge crystal splinters that bleed. Weak at first, a crowd shredder late.

name: Shatterstorm
text: Evolved form of Crystal Splinters. The last hit of the chain and every Keen blow shatter the splinters in the foes they hit, cutting every foe around.

name: Rift Wound
text: Warp strikes open rift wounds that drain the foe; each warp deepens them.

name: Rift Collapse
text: Evolved form of Rift Wound. A foe at full layers collapses: the wound's damage at once, doubled, and the rift pulls foes in and wounds them.

name: Static Charge
text: Dash through foes to charge them; they crackle, and your sword sets them off.

name: Overload
text: Evolved form of Static Charge. Charge never runs out, and each dash strikes up to 8 charged foes with lightning.

name: Phantom Edge
text: A sword blow from behind may call a phantom of Kael that repeats the blow.

name: Phantom Host
text: Evolved form of Phantom Edge. Phantoms come to any sword blow, no back blow needed, and stay on their foe repeating every blow.

name: Crystal Familiar
text: Casting may call a crystal familiar that fires homing shards.

name: Crystal Choir
text: Evolved form of Crystal Familiar. Three familiars, always out, and every shard arcs to another foe.

name: Mirror Knight
text: A parry or a perfect dodge calls a mirror knight that warp-strikes the attacker first, then the nearest foes.

name: Perfect Reflection
text: Evolved form of Mirror Knight. A parry or a perfect dodge stops time while Kael and the knight strike the attacker and every foe near.

name: Crystal Nova
text: The four charged skills on held J hit harder, reach further and charge faster.

name: Supernova
text: Evolved form of Crystal Nova. Every charged skill bursts two more times.

name: Measured Touch
text: The first thrust of the chain is a measured touch that strikes again.

name: Perfect Measure
text: Evolved form of Measured Touch. Every first thrust that lands calls a glass rapier through the foe.

name: Riposte Chain
text: A parry answers at once with a riposte, and the parry window grows.

name: Endless Riposte
text: Evolved form of Riposte Chain. For 2 s after a parry every thrust hits twice as hard.

name: Long Lunge
text: The lunge that ends the chain hits harder and pins.

name: Comet Lunge
text: Evolved form of Long Lunge. A lunge that lands readies the warp strike and the dash.

name: Pinning Point
text: The air thrust pins its foe and strikes again.

name: Butterfly Pin
text: Evolved form of Pinning Point. Each air thrust also skewers the foes below it.

name: Feint
text: The second thrust is a feint that opens the foe to your next blows.

name: Phantom Feint
text: Evolved form of Feint. A glass rapier strikes every opened foe from behind.

name: Rose Mark
text: The warp strike hits harder, recharges sooner and sets the Rose mark.

name: Crimson Seal
text: Evolved form of Rose Mark. The arrival marks every foe within 70 px.

name: Passing Touch
text: Dashing through foes cuts them.

name: Petal Step
text: Evolved form of Passing Touch. Every cut strikes twice more at half power.

name: Swallow Dive
text: More air thrusts, a cutting wall kick and a stomp after an air thrust.

name: Swallow Storm
text: Evolved form of Swallow Dive. The stomp reaches 70 px and draws foes in.

name: Rose Bloom
text: Rose Bloom strikes harder and leaves a ring of cutting petals.

name: Full Bloom
text: Evolved form of Rose Bloom. The bloom bursts on every foe within 60 px and binds them.

name: Needle Rain
text: Flurry calls needles of light down on its foe.

name: Starneedle Rain
text: Evolved form of Needle Rain. Flurry strikes its foe a second time.

name: Mirror Guard
text: Rose Line strikes harder and its light mirrors back from the foe it hits.

name: Perfect Mirror
text: Evolved form of Mirror Guard. Rose Line marks every foe within 50 px of the one it hits.

name: Thorn Wounds
text: Thrusts leave bleeding thorns.

name: Thorn Burst
text: Evolved form of Thorn Wounds. The lunge tears every thorn out at once for 1 AD each.

name: Weeping Mark
text: Foes carrying your Rose mark bleed.

name: Crimson Weep
text: Evolved form of Weeping Mark. A marked foe's bleeding spills onto every foe close to it at half strength.

name: Wilting Curse
text: A parry curses the attacker, and the curse eats at it.

name: Last Petal
text: Evolved form of Wilting Curse. The lunge tears the curse out at once for 3 AD a stack.

name: Mirror Blade
text: A parry or a perfect dodge can call a glass rapier that lunges through the foe.

name: Hall of Mirrors
text: Evolved form of Mirror Blade. After the call, glass rapiers keep lunging at the foe for 2 s.

name: Petal Blades
text: Casting a spell can call petal blades that dart at foes round you.

name: Rose Guard
text: Evolved form of Petal Blades. Five petal blades circle you for good and dart at every foe that comes close.

name: Thorn Sentinel
text: The lunge can plant a rapier of light in the floor that keeps thrusting at foes.

name: Thorn Garden
text: Evolved form of Thorn Sentinel. A sentinel bursts into petal blades when it fades, 6 AD round it.

name: Poise
text: More air dashes, an untouchable dash, and a stronger thrust after it.

name: Perfect Poise
text: Evolved form of Poise. Every dash readies the warp strike.

name: Grace
text: The warp's arrival pours the selected spell into the rapier and heals you.

name: Rose Grace
text: Evolved form of Grace. Every arrival readies the selected spell at once.

name: Rose Tempest
text: The four Rose Tempest charged skills on held J hit harder.

name: Rose Storm
text: Evolved form of Rose Tempest. Every charged skill sends four more streaks, two each way.

name: Oathblade
text: Oath cut, the first blow of the chain, adds a cut of light and later throws waves.

name: Sunblade
text: Evolved form of Oathblade. Every blow of the chain throws a great wave of light that passes through every foe.

name: Breaking Bash
text: The Shield bash, the second blow of the chain, staggers, shocks the foes behind and leaves them open.

name: Shattering Bash
text: Evolved form of Breaking Bash. The bash bursts the Sunbrand stacks of every foe it shocks.

name: Iron Retort
text: A longer parry window, and the parry strikes back with the shield.

name: Retribution
text: Evolved form of Iron Retort. A parry throws a wave of light both ways.

name: Verdict
text: More Sky cuts in the air, and each one that lands calls swords of light down on its foe.

name: Final Verdict
text: Evolved form of Verdict. Every blow of the ground chain also calls a sword of light on its foe.

name: Crestfall
text: Crest breaker, the last blow of the chain, hits far harder, knocks down and shakes the floor.

name: Dawnbreak
text: Evolved form of Crestfall. Crest breaker calls three pillars of light in a row ahead.

name: Shield Step
text: Dashing through foes bashes them with the shield.

name: Phalanx Step
text: Evolved form of Shield Step. Every dash ends in a ring of light.

name: Bulwark Arrival
text: The warp strike hits harder, recharges faster and lands in a ring of light.

name: Twin Bulwark
text: Evolved form of Bulwark Arrival. Every 4 s an arrival recharges the warp at once.

name: Skyfall
text: More air slashes, a cutting wall kick, and a shield slam where you land.

name: Falling Sun
text: Evolved form of Skyfall. The slam calls a pillar of light where you land.

name: Dawn Lance
text: Dawn Lance strikes harder, burns, marks deeper and bursts.

name: Spear of Morning
text: Evolved form of Dawn Lance. Every lance that strikes calls a sword of light down on its foe.

name: Mending Light
text: Mending Light heals more, pushes foes away and leaves burning light.

name: Absolution
text: Evolved form of Mending Light. Mending Light lays full Penance on every foe it strikes.

name: High Sun
text: Sunpillar stuns longer, strikes harder, burns and falls in a row.

name: Zenith
text: Evolved form of High Sun. Every pillar strikes twice.

name: Sunbrand
text: The Shield bash brands the foes it strikes with burning light that stacks.

name: Solar Brand
text: Evolved form of Sunbrand. A branded foe that falls bursts and brands every foe near it to the full.

name: Penance
text: A foe whose blow you block burns with Penance. Grows with ability power.

name: Atonement
text: Evolved form of Penance. When a foe's Penance fills it bursts, each stack a heavy hit.

name: Lingering Dawn
text: Sunpillar leaves burning light on the floor where it falls. Grows with ability power.

name: High Noon
text: Evolved form of Lingering Dawn. The burning light calls a small pillar on a foe in it every second.

name: Oathsworn
text: A parry may call a knight of light who cuts the attacker.

name: Honour Guard
text: Evolved form of Oathsworn. Two knights answer, each cutting three times.

name: Sun Lion
text: A foe falling may call a lion of light that pounces on foes.

name: Pride of Dawn
text: Evolved form of Sun Lion. Three lions walk with him always.

name: Dawn Falcon
text: Casting a spell may send a falcon of light swooping through the foes ahead.

name: Sunbird
text: Evolved form of Dawn Falcon. Falcons swoop three times and set the foes they pass burning.

name: Resolve
text: More air dashes, healing dashes and a harder blow after each dash.

name: Unbroken
text: Evolved form of Resolve. Every dash lays burning dawn light where it ends.

name: Iron Vow
text: Each warp arrival pours the selected spell into the sword, and spell cooldowns are shorter.

name: Iron Fortress
text: Evolved form of Iron Vow. Every warp arrival readies the selected spell.

name: Sanctuary
text: The four charged skills hit harder, draw foes in, charge faster and echo.

name: Dawn Citadel
text: Evolved form of Sanctuary. Every charged skill bursts twice more.

name: Rising Edge
text: The dusk cross, your first cut, bites deeper and leaves night echoes.

name: Crescendo
text: Evolved form of Rising Edge. Every dusk cross also throws a pair of crossing dusk waves ahead for 1.5 AD each.

name: Twin Keen
text: The rising pair, your second cut, is followed by a quick short-blade cut.

name: Perfect Pair
text: Evolved form of Twin Keen. A landed rising pair cuts every foe within 60 px twice with sure crits.

name: Sky Ribbon
text: One more air cut per jump, and air cuts hit harder.

name: Heaven's Ribbon
text: Evolved form of Sky Ribbon. Each air cut also sends a dusk wave diving down ahead for 2 AD.

name: Crossing Storm
text: The moonrise, your third cut, hits harder and sends crossing dusk waves.

name: Thousand Crossings
text: Evolved form of Crossing Storm. The moonrise sends four pairs of waves, two each way, and each foe it cuts takes a night echo.

name: Turning Blade
text: A longer parry window, and a parry turns into a short-blade cut.

name: Whirling Mirror
text: Evolved form of Turning Blade. A parry also spins both blades in a ring of night cuts, 3 AD to every foe within 60 px.

name: Ascending Step
text: More air dashes, and the wall kick cuts what it passes.

name: Moonlit Steps
text: Evolved form of Ascending Step. Kicks and jump cuts reach 56 px and leave a dusk ring.

name: Thrown Dusk
text: The warp strike recharges faster and hits harder, and the arrival cuts in a cross.

name: Twin Throw
text: Evolved form of Thrown Dusk. The short blade follows the long one: the arrival cut strikes a second time a moment later.

name: Slipstream
text: Dashing through foes cuts them.

name: Dusk Current
text: Evolved form of Slipstream. Every dash that passes a foe also throws a pair of crossing dusk waves ahead for 1.5 AD.

name: Falling Moon
text: Falling Moon strikes harder and drops more moons.

name: Eclipse
text: Evolved form of Falling Moon. Each moon brings an eclipse: three more moons fall around it for 1.8 AD each.

name: Dusk Gale
text: Dusk Gale hits harder and blows in more gusts.

name: Twilight Cyclone
text: Evolved form of Dusk Gale. A gale hit lifts the foe and every foe within 40 px into the air and cuts them.

name: Dusk Thread
text: Dusk Thread hits harder and runs on to more foes.

name: Fate Thread
text: Evolved form of Dusk Thread. A thread hit recharges the warp at once.

name: Dusk Sigil
text: Your cuts lay dusk sigils that cut the foe on each tick.

name: Sigil Bloom
text: Evolved form of Dusk Sigil. Falling Moon blooms every sigil on the foes it strikes.

name: Falling Night
text: Foes you strike in the air carry night that keeps cutting them.

name: Starless Night
text: Evolved form of Falling Night. The moonrise takes all the night on each foe it cuts, each stack a blow of 0.8 times attack damage.

name: Afterglow
text: Foes your dash passes glow with dusk that burns each tick.

name: Dusk Fire
text: Evolved form of Afterglow. Every dash flares all afterglow on the stage, three ticks at once.

name: Dusk Shade
text: Your blows may call a shade of you that dashes through the foe.

name: Shade Troupe
text: Evolved form of Dusk Shade. Every blow calls a shade, as often as its wait allows.

name: Night Swallows
text: Throwing a foe up may send dusk swallows diving at foes in the air.

name: Swallow Storm
text: Evolved form of Night Swallows. Six swallows circle you and dive at every launch.

name: Twin Phantom
text: A parry or perfect dodge calls a phantom of you to cut the nearest foe.

name: Mirror Dance
text: Evolved form of Twin Phantom. Two phantoms come, and while one is out your blows deal 30% more.

name: Dusk Waltz
text: Dusk Waltz, the four charged tiers, grows: harder, faster to charge, with more dancing cuts.

name: Endless Waltz
text: Evolved form of Dusk Waltz. Every charged tier dances a second time half a second later at 60%.

name: Unbroken Rhythm
text: Landed cuts shorten the warp's recharge, and arrivals speed up your spells.

name: Perpetual Tempo
text: Evolved form of Unbroken Rhythm. Every warp arrival readies the selected spell at once.

name: Wanderer's Grace
text: Untouchable while dashing, with more air dashes and a dusk shade left behind.

name: Dusk Ward
text: Evolved form of Wanderer's Grace. The dusk shade cuts twice and twice as wide.

name: Honed Draw
text: The draw cut, the first of the chain, hits harder and stores more in the foe.

name: Moonlit Draw
text: Evolved form of Honed Draw. Every draw cut sends a second ink cut, higher, and the cuts it stores release at once.

name: Clean Sheathe
text: The sheathe, the last of the chain, hits harder and its release pays more.

name: Perfect Stillness
text: Evolved form of Clean Sheathe. Every sheathe releases twice in full.

name: Reverse Edge
text: The return cut, the second of the chain, also cuts the foes behind her.

name: Full Circle
text: Evolved form of Reverse Edge. The return cut becomes a full circle: it cuts all around her twice.

name: Ink Flow
text: A warp arrival pours ink into the blade, and spell cooldowns are shorter.

name: Spreading Ink
text: Evolved form of Ink Flow. Every warp arrival readies the selected spell at once.

name: Falling Moon
text: More air slashes, and landing after one releases her stored cuts.

name: Moonfall
text: Evolved form of Falling Moon. The landing after an air slash crashes down for 4x AD around her and knocks foes down.

name: Passing Draw
text: The warp strike recharges faster, hits harder and stores more.

name: Thousand Paces
text: Evolved form of Passing Draw. Once every 3 seconds an arrival recharges the warp at once.

name: Shadow Step
text: She cannot be hit while dashing, and gains air dashes and an afterimage cut.

name: Ghost Passage
text: Evolved form of Shadow Step. Afterimages cut twice, twice as wide.

name: Long Stroke
text: Dashing through foes cuts them like a brush stroke.

name: Ink Horizon
text: Evolved form of Long Stroke. The dash cut also strikes every foe up to 60 px past where she stops.

name: Crescent Wave
text: Crescent Wave hits harder and stores a cut in every foe it strikes.

name: Tide Moon
text: Evolved form of Crescent Wave. Each Crescent Wave hit calls a small shower of Ink Rain on the foe.

name: Ink Rain
text: Ink Rain hits harder, holds foes longer and marks them.

name: Monsoon
text: Evolved form of Ink Rain. Ink Rain keeps falling: three more showers.

name: Still Water
text: Still Water holds foes longer and hits harder.

name: Mirror Lake
text: Evolved form of Still Water. Still Water's release is in full and every cut is a sure critical hit.

name: Weeping Cut
text: Released cuts keep weeping: the foe bleeds for a while after each release.

name: Weeping Moon
text: Evolved form of Weeping Cut. A release on a foe with 6 or more stacks bursts them all at once for 2 attack damage each.

name: Ink Stain
text: A cut waiting in a foe stains it: the foe takes a share of it every second until the sheathe.

name: Indelible
text: Evolved form of Ink Stain. A release leaves half of each foe's cut stored in it for the next sheathe.

name: Lingering Line
text: Infused hits leave a bleeding ink line in the foe.

name: Ink Sea
text: Evolved form of Lingering Line. Every slash leaves the bleeding ink line, infused or not.

name: Ink Crane
text: When stored cuts release, an ink crane may fold itself from the splash and fly at a foe.

name: Thousand Cranes
text: Evolved form of Ink Crane. Every full release folds a crane for each foe it struck.

name: Ink Shade
text: A parry or a perfect dodge may leave an ink shade of her that draws once on the nearest foe.

name: Twin Moon
text: Evolved form of Ink Shade. Two shades come each time, one each side of the foe, and each draws twice.

name: Paper Blades
text: A foe that falls may leave a paper blade that circles her and cuts.

name: Paper Storm
text: Evolved form of Paper Blades. Every kill folds a blade, up to 8, and they circle wider.

name: Feather Step
text: Wall kicks and dash-jumps cut, and she gains air dashes and air slashes.

name: Boundless Breath
text: Evolved form of Feather Step. Every jump sends an ink crescent ahead that stores in each foe.

name: Calm Mind
text: A wider parry, and a parry draws the blade at the attacker.

name: Empty Mind
text: Evolved form of Calm Mind. For 3 seconds after a parry every slash is a sure critical hit.

name: Silent Moon
text: The four charged skills on held J hit harder, charge faster, and store and release her cuts.

name: New Moon
text: Evolved form of Silent Moon. Every charged skill releases twice in full.

name: Twin Echo
text: Crane Wheel, the second cut, sends your spirit swords thrusting ahead.

name: Myriad Echo
text: Evolved form of Twin Echo. Echo thrusts are sure critical hits and reach 110 px.

name: Flowing Water
text: Willow Cut, the first cut, sends a qi wave ahead.

name: Still Water
text: Evolved form of Flowing Water. The waves run 160 px and hold the feet of each foe they cut.

name: High Tide
text: Returning Tide, the third cut, runs a qi crescent along the floor.

name: Spring Tide
text: Evolved form of High Tide. The crescents run both ways at once.

name: Crane's Reach
text: A wider parry window, and parries send a qi wave at the attacker.

name: White Crane
text: Evolved form of Crane's Reach. Every parry sends three waves at three heights.

name: Petal Storm
text: More air cuts, and each one that lands scatters cutting petals below.

name: Blossom Fall
text: Evolved form of Petal Storm. Landing after an air cut sends crescents both ways.

name: Cloud Step
text: More air cuts, cutting wall kicks and a qi ring where you land.

name: Cloud Walker
text: Evolved form of Cloud Step. The landing ring reaches 70 px and holds foes' feet.

name: Sword Riding
text: The warp strike recharges faster and hits harder, and spirit swords follow you in.

name: Riding the Wind
text: Evolved form of Sword Riding. Once every 4 seconds an arrival recharges the warp at once.

name: Drifting Leaf
text: Dashing through foes cuts them.

name: Leaf on the Wind
text: Evolved form of Drifting Leaf. Each dash cuts twice.

name: Sword Fan
text: Sword Stream cuts harder and fans out into more spirit swords.

name: Peacock Fan
text: Evolved form of Sword Fan. Every Stream fans out into eight extra swords.

name: Sword Cage
text: Sword Lotus holds foes longer and cuts again.

name: Jade Prison
text: Evolved form of Sword Cage. The lotus keeps spinning, cutting three more times.

name: Qi Crescent
text: Qi Crescent cuts harder and carries on past its target.

name: Moon Crescent
text: Evolved form of Qi Crescent. Each crescent that lands splits into two more.

name: Lingering Qi
text: Your cuts leave qi wounds that cut foes over time.

name: Qi Burst
text: Evolved form of Lingering Qi. Wounds burst when a foe carries the most it can, for 0.8 attack damage a stack.

name: Thousand Cuts
text: Your sword arts' cuts leave bleeding wounds.

name: Thousand Petals
text: Evolved form of Thousand Cuts. When a Sword Lotus ends, every wounded foe takes all its wounds at once.

name: Jade Needle
text: A parry lodges jade needles in the attacker that bleed qi.

name: Acupuncture
text: Evolved form of Jade Needle. At 12 needles they all burst at once for 6 attack damage each.

name: Guardian Blade
text: A landed blow may call a guardian blade that circles you and strikes foes near.

name: Heavenly Guard
text: Evolved form of Guardian Blade. Three guardian blades circle you all the time.

name: Jade Heron
text: Casting may call a jade heron that flies through the line ahead.

name: Heron Flight
text: Evolved form of Jade Heron. Every cast calls three herons.

name: Sage's Shade
text: A parry calls your shade behind the attacker for a heavy cut.

name: Many Shades
text: Evolved form of Sage's Shade. The shade cuts three times at half again the power.

name: Sage's Breath
text: More air dashes, and each dash ends in a ring of qi.

name: Sword Sea
text: Evolved form of Sage's Breath. Each air dash sends three spirit swords thrusting ahead.

name: Harmony
text: The warp and the sword arts move as one: arrivals fill the jian, and art cooldowns are shorter.

name: Perfect Harmony
text: Evolved form of Harmony. Every arrival readies the selected sword art at once.

name: Heaven's Grove
text: Jade Rain on held J hits harder, charges faster and drops spirit swords on the foes near you.

name: Endless Rain
text: Evolved form of Heaven's Grove. After every Jade Rain the swords keep falling for 4 seconds.

name: Heavy Hands
text: The air slash, Falling Slam, hits harder and comes more often.

name: Meteor Hands
text: Evolved form of Heavy Hands. Every air slash quakes the floor below her and throws foes up.

name: Wide Arc
text: The first slash, Wide Sweep, cuts harder and drags the crowd into the chain.

name: Horizon Cleave
text: Evolved form of Wide Arc. Every first slash throws a crimson crescent both ways.

name: Skyward Heave
text: The second slash, Rising Heave, throws foes up for the slam and the air slash.

name: Skyfall
text: Evolved form of Skyward Heave. Foes the heave throws crash down after a moment for 2 AD.

name: Anvil Weight
text: The third slash, Anvil Slam, sends a shockwave along the floor.

name: Split Earth
text: Evolved form of Anvil Weight. Every slam also raises a line of crimson pillars ahead.

name: Counter Cleave
text: A parry answers with a heavy cleave on every foe in front of her.

name: Iron Answer
text: Evolved form of Counter Cleave. A block also answers with a half-power cleave.

name: Spinning Throw
text: The warp strike recharges sooner, hits harder and lands with a shock ring.

name: Anvil Drop
text: Evolved form of Spinning Throw. Every arrival quakes the floor and throws foes up.

name: Crater Leap
text: A hard landing from a jump craters the floor round her.

name: Crater Pull
text: Evolved form of Crater Leap. The landing drags foes in and splits fissures both ways.

name: Shoulder Charge
text: The dash shoulders every foe it passes through.

name: Battering Ram
text: Evolved form of Shoulder Charge. Every dash that shoulders a foe ends in a floor wave ahead.

name: Ember Arc
text: Ember Arc burns longer and blasts what it hits.

name: Wildfire Arc
text: Evolved form of Ember Arc. Each foe Ember Arc hits sends a crimson crescent on along the line.

name: Brand Pillars
text: Quake raises crimson pillars under the foe it shakes.

name: Aftershock
text: Evolved form of Brand Pillars. Quake strikes again half a second later where it struck.

name: War Cry
text: A warp arrival roars and pours the selected spell into the blade.

name: Battle Roar
text: Evolved form of War Cry. Every warp arrival readies the selected spell at once.

name: Cinder Edge
text: Her slashes lay searing embers, and the third slash lays the most.

name: Forge Heart
text: Evolved form of Cinder Edge. A foe filled with embers bursts into a crimson blast that burns those round it.

name: Fault Lines
text: The third slash and her shockwaves leave burning cracks in the floor.

name: Rift Floor
text: Evolved form of Fault Lines. When a crack burns out, it bursts up along its whole length.

name: Crushing Weight
text: Her second and third slashes crush foes, and crushed foes bleed.

name: Grindstone
text: Evolved form of Crushing Weight. Her third slash on a crushed foe grinds all its stacks out at once.

name: Falling Blade
text: Kills may call a phantom greatsword down from the sky onto the next foe.

name: Blade Rain
text: Evolved form of Falling Blade. Blades keep falling on foes near her for 1.5 s after a kill calls them.

name: Echo Swing
text: A parry calls a crimson echo of her behind the attacker that brings down a heavy cleave.

name: Twin Echo
text: Evolved form of Echo Swing. Two echoes, one on each side, and each cleave hits half again as hard.

name: Heart Splinter
text: A warp strike splinters the crystal in Anvilheart, and the red splinters dart at foes on their own.

name: Crimson Halo
text: Evolved form of Heart Splinter. Four splinters circle her for good and dart out at every foe near her.

name: Iron Skin
text: Her dash and air dash cannot be hurt, and she gets more air dashes.

name: Living Anvil
text: Evolved form of Iron Skin. Every dash leaves a shock ring round her.

name: Bloodletter
text: Rend cuts deeper bleeding wounds.

name: Red Tide
text: Evolved form of Bloodletter. Each Rend that strikes runs a floor wave on along its line.

name: Crimson Fall
text: The four tiers of Crimson Fall on held J hit harder, reach farther and charge faster.

name: Crimson Cataclysm
text: Evolved form of Crimson Fall. Every charged skill shakes the floor twice more.

name: Whirling Edge
text: The sweep turn, the first slash of the chain, hits harder and throws sand crescents out both sides.

name: Endless Turn
text: Evolved form of Whirling Edge. Every sweep turn throws two crescents each way, and every slash reaches 25% farther.

name: Sirocco Descent
text: The spinning descent, the air slash, hits harder, comes more often and sends hot gusts along the floor.

name: Desert Noon
text: Evolved form of Sirocco Descent. Every air slash that lands calls a ring of noon light round you, 6 times attack damage to every foe within 40 px.

name: Opened Veins
text: The twin turn, the chain's finisher, hits harder for each wound on the foe, then tears the wounds open.

name: Red Wind
text: Evolved form of Opened Veins. Every slash tears one wound open on each foe it cuts, for 1.2 times attack damage.

name: Two-Faced Cut
text: The rising turn, the second slash, hits harder, and every cut behind you hits harder too.

name: Mirror Dance
text: Evolved form of Two-Faced Cut. Every rising turn throws a mirror ring behind you that cuts every foe there for twice attack damage, and cuts behind you deal 50% more.

name: Falling Dune
text: More air slashes and air dashes, and landing after an air slash throws a ring of sand both ways.

name: Meteor Dune
text: Evolved form of Falling Dune. The landing ring also throws up a sandspout each way.

name: Dune Walk
text: Dashing through foes cuts them, and stepping through your slashes leaves a trail of sand that cuts.

name: Shifting Sands
text: Evolved form of Dune Walk. Every dash throws a sand crescent out each side as it ends, and the trail opens two wounds.

name: Whirlwind Arrival
text: The warp strike recharges sooner and hits harder, and the arrival spins a ring of sand round you.

name: Dust Devil Step
text: Evolved form of Whirlwind Arrival. Every arrival leaves a small sandstorm turning round you for 1.5 s.

name: Sand Slip
text: More air dashes, a dash nothing can touch, and a cloud of sand that blinds the foes you slip past.

name: Mirage Slip
text: Evolved form of Sand Slip. A dash past foes leaves a mirage where it started, which minions strike at and which bursts into sand blades.

name: Hot Gale
text: The crescent rides a hot gale: it hits harder, comes back for a second cut and bleeds what it touches.

name: Simoom
text: Evolved form of Hot Gale. Every crescent hit tears all the foe's wounds open at once, 1 attack damage each.

name: Glass Rain
text: Glass Rain scours harder: longer blindness, shards that rain on the foes round the target, and shorter spell cooldowns.

name: Glass Storm
text: Evolved form of Glass Rain. Every glass blast also strikes the nearest foe behind you.

name: Quicksand
text: Sandspout sinks what it catches: it hits harder, holds foes in place and opens more wounds.

name: Sinking Sea
text: Evolved form of Quicksand. Every Sandspout hit raises a whirl of sand that runs on through the foes behind.

name: Deep Wounds
text: Your wounds bleed harder, go deeper and stay open longer.

name: Crimson Tide
text: Evolved form of Deep Wounds. Wounds bleed twice as often and never close while the sand ring turns.

name: Scouring Sand
text: The sand ring grinds grit into foes that bleeds on its own; full of grit, they fuse to glass and shatter.

name: Glassing Wind
text: Evolved form of Scouring Sand. Every slash grinds grit in, and a shatter cuts every foe round it.

name: Desert Thirst
text: Bleeding foes take more from everything, more for each wound; felling them gives back HP.

name: Thirst of the Hawk
text: Evolved form of Desert Thirst. Every bleeding foe you fell calls a desert hawk at once.

name: Sand Wraith
text: A slash that lands may call a sand wraith that whirls through the foes ahead.

name: Wraith Caravan
text: Evolved form of Sand Wraith. A wraith walks round you all the time and cuts every foe it passes.

name: Mirage Dancer
text: A parry may call a mirage dancer beside the attacker that spins through it and the foes round it.

name: Court of Mirages
text: Evolved form of Mirage Dancer. The dancers' last spin bursts into sand blades, 40 times attack damage on the attacker.

name: Desert Hawk
text: A foe you fell may call a desert hawk that dives on the nearest foe and opens its wounds.

name: Sky of Hawks
text: Evolved form of Desert Hawk. Every kill calls a hawk, at most one every 0.6 s, and each dive opens three wounds.

name: Unbroken Whirl
text: The warp feeds the Whirl and the blade: an arrival fills the Whirl and pours the selected spell into the scimitar.

name: Eye of the Dune
text: Evolved form of Unbroken Whirl. The Whirl never drains below the first ring, and every arrival readies the selected spell.

name: Sand Veil
text: Your veil of sand parries more easily, blocks more for less, blinds attackers, and your mirage bursts wider and harder.

name: Wall of Dunes
text: Evolved form of Sand Veil. A parry leaves two mirages, one each side of you.

name: Sandstorm
text: The four Sandstorm tiers hit harder, charge faster, reach farther and leave the storm turning longer.

name: Endless Sirocco
text: Evolved form of Sandstorm. Every tier from the third raises a second, wider storm, and every storm lasts twice as long.

name: Hair Trigger
text: The first cut fires a round into the wound.

name: Dead Center
text: Evolved form of Hair Trigger. Every cut that fires a round fires two.

name: Breech Slam
text: The third cut slams down hard enough to shake the floor.

name: Faultline
text: Evolved form of Breech Slam. The slam tears a fault line along the floor that bursts four times ahead.

name: Vent Blast
text: The second cut vents a blast from the chamber ahead.

name: Furnace Vent
text: Evolved form of Vent Blast. Every cut of the chain vents.

name: Point Blank
text: A wider parry, and a parry answers with a heavy round.

name: Deadeye
text: Evolved form of Point Blank. A parry's counter also fires into every foe in a line ahead.

name: Speed Loader
text: A warp arrival loads the selected shell into the blade.

name: Spin Cycle
text: Evolved form of Speed Loader. Every warp arrival readies the selected shell at once.

name: Ricochet
text: Air cuts fire a round that ricochets on to other foes.

name: Pinball
text: Evolved form of Ricochet. Air rounds ricochet six times.

name: Recoil Dash
text: Dashing through foes fires a round into each.

name: Backfire Rush
text: Evolved form of Recoil Dash. Every dash ends with a backfire blast behind.

name: Tracer Warp
text: A faster, harder warp strike that leaves a cutting tracer.

name: Green Line
text: Evolved form of Tracer Warp. The tracer fires a round into every foe along it.

name: Blast Jump
text: One more air cut, and jumps blast off the floor.

name: Skyshot
text: Evolved form of Blast Jump. Landing from a long fall blasts everything within 70 px.

name: Phosphor Shell
text: Phosphor Shell hits harder and its green fire spreads.

name: Greenfire Barrage
text: Evolved form of Phosphor Shell. Four shells a cast, and their fire burns twice as hot.

name: Chain Shot
text: Chain Shot hits harder and arcs on to more foes.

name: Reaper Chain
text: Evolved form of Chain Shot. Chain Shot strikes twice.

name: Blast Charge
text: Blast Charge hits harder and throws foes.

name: Demolition
text: Evolved form of Blast Charge. Every cast lays a row of charges, and each blast is far wider.

name: Shrapnel
text: Every round's blast leaves shrapnel that bleeds the foes it struck.

name: Shrapnel Storm
text: Evolved form of Shrapnel. A blast on a foe carrying 6 stacks or more detonates them all round it.

name: Scorch Rounds
text: A round fired into the wound sets the foe burning green.

name: Phosphor Heart
text: Evolved form of Scorch Rounds. A round into a foe burning with 4 stacks or more consumes the fire in one burst.

name: Hot Brass
text: Every sixth round fired flings hot casings at foes nearby, burning them.

name: Brass Rain
text: Evolved form of Hot Brass. Casings rain on every foe on screen.

name: Spare Barrel
text: A parry may plant a spare barrel on legs that shoots the nearest foe.

name: Gun Nest
text: Evolved form of Spare Barrel. Three barrels at once, firing faster and harder.

name: Smoke Double
text: A round fired into the wound may leave a double of gunsmoke that fires it again.

name: Gunsmoke Gallery
text: Evolved form of Smoke Double. Two doubles at a time, each firing three rounds.

name: Scrap Hound
text: A foe falling may call a clockwork hound that runs down and bites the nearest foe.

name: Scrap Pack
text: Evolved form of Scrap Hound. Three hounds, always at your side.

name: Drum Cylinder
text: More air dashes, and dashes that leave rounds behind.

name: Bottomless Drum
text: Evolved form of Drum Cylinder. Every dash recharges the warp strike.

name: Cylinder Break
text: Breach Cut, Buckshot Wall, Green Line and Cylinder Break, the four charged skills on held J, hit harder.

name: Last Cylinder
text: Evolved form of Cylinder Break. Every charged skill bursts twice more into every foe it reached.

name: Mire Spit
text: Spit bog rot that poisons and slows.

name: Gloam Lantern
text: A ghost lantern drops and burns the foe ahead.

name: Rift Lance
text: A lance of rift lightning that shocks.

name: Forge Flare
text: Molten iron erupts from the floor ahead.

name: Rime Fang
text: A fang of ice that freezes what it bites.

name: Gale Call
text: Thunder falls on the foe ahead and blows foes back.

name: Spore Burst
text: Spores burst on the foe ahead and linger, poisoning.

name: Ink Tide
text: Rolling ink hits and marks foes.

name: Whetstone
text: Attack damage +4%.

name: Focus
text: Ability power +4%.

name: Keen Eye
text: Critical chance +1.5%.

name: Deeper Charge
text: Charged skills deal more damage and charge faster.
